chapter: Biddle, Durham and early road shows
title: Taking over the band at Watkins's theater in Durham
summary: He returned to Durham to lead the band at a theater owned by Watkins for three or four months before going home to Arkansas.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: I took over that show there and I played there for awhile. Didn't last any too long. Then what I did, I went right back home after I left -- after I played -- I guess we stayed in that theater about three or four months. Then I went back home to --
